items.title: Base change for the internal hom: pullback of R-Hom is R-Hom of the pullbacks in three cases
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the canonical comparison map Lh^* R-Hom(K, M) -> R-Hom(Lh^*K, Lh^*M) is an isomorphism in three separate situations: K perfect; h flat with K pseudo-coherent and M bounded below; and finite tor dimension of O_X over h^{-1}O_Y with K pseudo-coherent and M bounded below. The proof of the first case reduces locally to a strictly perfect representative of K and a K-flat representative of M, computes R-Hom(K, M) as the single complex of Homs between them, and compares the pullback with the internal hom of the pullbacks using the description of pullback of finite free modules (proof lines 13426-13480). The remaining cases require the flatness and tor dimension hypotheses to make the same computation valid. H3: the local computation and the three-way case analysis are independent research-level work, not a citation chain.
